fieldValues.name: srs-rust
fieldValues.tagline: One core behind a CLI, WebAssembly bindings and an MCP server.
fieldValues.summary: A library-first reference implementation. The core holds types and validation. One repository service sits over it and is exposed as a command line with a stable JSON contract, as WASM bindings and as an MCP server.
fieldValues.audience: Engineers who script, validate or embed SRS, and agents that need a tool-enforced way to write records.
fieldValues.makes_possible: Every client gets the same answer, because the logic exists once.
